description: Farm-gate producer prices by country for one commodity and year, from FAOSTAT. Use for 'where is this cheap at source' and for comparing what growers are actually paid across countries. THIS IS NOT A BENCHMARK: a producer price is what the farmer received, and differs from price.latest and from the export unit value in trade.partners — all three can be correct and several-fold apart. Covers seven crops only (ZC ZW ZS ZR KC CC CT); sugar, palm and livestock are deliberately unmapped because FAOSTAT prices a different product for those. Annual, usually one to two years behind.

commodity.description: Instrument code. Example: KC for coffee.

year.description: Four-digit year; defaults to the latest available.

name: producer.prices

far_from_peers.description: Outside the peer band, either direction. Means 'worth a second look', NOT 'bad data' — the band catches both micro specialty crops and genuinely cheap large producers. Do not discard rows on this flag.

flag.description: FAO flag: A official, E estimated, I imputed, X external

m49.description: M49 code — joins to trade.flow country codes

usd_per_catalog_unit.description: The same figure in the instrument's own unit, null where no honest mass conversion exists

notes.description: Read before presenting any figure from this tool.

peer_band_multiple.description: The multiple of the median beyond which far_from_peers is set

vs_median_available.description: False when too few countries report for a median to mean anything

title: Producer Prices by Country
